messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected in eu-central-gateway (5m avg 9.8%). Root metric: gateway->inference 5xx spike. link: https://metrics.redwood.example/alerts/2987654321
maya: seeing the alert, paging infra oncall @sam — I’ll gather logs.
sam: on it, I’m pulling gateway logs and the ingress proxy traces. can someone check if any deploys landed in euc1 in the last 10m?
kevin: no deploys in eu-central from release pipeline in that window. last deploy was 18m ago.
atalie: customer-facing note: some customers in EU experiencing 502/504s when calling completion endpoint. estimated affected sessions ~3-5% of EU traffic.
jordan: confirmed spike across fronting proxies -> increased conn resets into mlworkers. looks like connection saturation to vecpool-01.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: eu-gateway-5xx-spike-v2 — steps: 1) Check pool health `curl -s http://vecpool-01/health` 2) Increase edgepool capacity `edgectl pool scale eu-central 20` 3) Enable fallback routing to eu-west: `edgectl route add --from eu-central --to eu-west --percent 30` 4) If error persists, evacuate pool.
sam: running health now... `curl -s http://vecpool-01/health` -> reports 503 on 3/5 nodes, high load and high conn_count.
maya: ok, start gradual fallback to eu-west to avoid total outage. Jordan, can you open a 30% route shift now?
jordan: executing: ```bash
edgectl route add --from eu-central --to eu-west --percent 30 --reason "auto-mitigation-2987654321"
```
jordan: command accepted, traffic shift started. monitoring.
kevin: also bumping pool capacity: ```bash
edgectl pool scale eu-central vecpool-01 --replicas 10
```
kevin: scale started, pods coming up.
pagerduty: paging maya and sam (ack required)
maya: acked. I’m going to tail gateway logs and collect sample request ids for impacted customers.
sam: digging into conntrack and NAT metrics — we’re seeing conntrack table nearing 95% on the NAT gateways for euc1. possible connection leak from mlworker keepalives.
natalie: customer comms draft: "We are currently seeing elevated 502/504 errors for EU customers. Engineers are mitigating by routing traffic to a healthy region. We will post updates in 15 minutes." ok to send?
maya: send after first successful 30% shift shows reduced 5xx on metrics for 5m.
jordan: after shift, 5xx dropped to 6.1% in the first 3m. still high but trending down. :eyes:
kevin: conntrack evictions spiked during the shift — we should avoid moving too much at once. revert to 20% and let pool scale finish.
jordan: updating route to 20% now.
ops-runbook-bot: Note: if NAT conntrack > 90% for >10m, escalate to network infra to request ephemeral increase or rotate NAT gateway.
sam: I'm triggering a NAT rotate on euc1 now (rolling NAT gateway replace). this should free table entries.
sam: started NAT rotate — rolling replace gw-nat-1 -> gw-nat-2.
jordan: after NAT rotate and scale, 5xx is 2.4% and response latency back to baseline for most customers.
maya: good. preparing handoff to day oncall — will keep watch for 30m, then close incident channel if stable.
natalie: sent customer update: "Issue being mitigated by routing some EU traffic to EU-West and scaling capacity. We'll follow up after stability check."
kevin: engineers found an mlworker variant misconfigured with aggressive keepalive settings causing lots of half-open connections. ticket created: BUG-4621.
maya: created incident ticket IR-2987654321 with summary and next steps (rollback config for worker variant; add conntrack alerting). assigning to kevin for patch.
kevin: will roll patch in canary and then stage; estimate 60m to fix and verify.
jordan: keeping 15% cross-region shift until patch lands and NAT metrics stable.
natalie: tracking customer list: fintech-prod, search-api, chat-widget; ops will send targeted follow-ups.
sam: final checks: no deploys required, mitigation via routing and pool scale completed. NAT rotate cleared conntrack pressure.
maya: handing off to day-oncall @kevin in 20m for verification and to coordinate the config rollback. I’ll remain available for any surprises.
ops-runbook-bot: Post-incident checklist: 1) Confirm patched config deployed 2) Update runbook with conntrack thresholds and NAT rotate steps 3) Schedule follow-up with network infra 4) Notify CS for customer follow-ups.
kevin: ack handoff. I’ll drive the bugfix and follow-ups.
natalie: will coordinate postmortem comms and customer impact summary.
maya: incident channel will stay open for 60m after handoff; closing if steady. thanks all for fast response :thumbsup:
sam: note for postmortem — add telemetry for mlworker keepalive histogram and per-pool conn_count; current dashboards are per-region only.
jordan: snapshot of metrics and traces saved under link: https://dashboards.redwood.example/d/incident/2987654321
kevin: created PR for config revert: https://git.redwood.example/r/patches/1234 — running canary now.
maya: canary looks good after 10m. 5xx stable at 0.8%. pushing staged rollout for config revert.
ops-runbook-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.
natalie: customer impact notes: ~4% EU requests affected during peak; primary customers impacted: fintech-prod (brief retries), chat-widget (elevated latency).
kevin: will open follow-up RFC for default keepalive behavior and add unit tests for connection handling.
maya: closing escalation. final handoff to @kevin. thanks team. :party_popper:
